ValidationRule.description: Once the Opportunity has reached Stages 6 or 7, Sales users cannot make further changes to the opportunity #21200- Deacting the VR
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ((ISPICKVAL(StageName , '7 - Closed') || ISPICKVAL(StageName , '6 - Setup')) && NOT(ISCHANGED(StageName))) && ($Profile.Name = "IM_Sales" || $Profile.Name = "IM_Sales_eSignature" || $Profile.Name = "IM_Sales_Schedule_A" || $Profile.Name = "IM_Account Manager" || $Profile.Name = "IM_Account Manager Special" || $Profile.Name = "IM_Account Manager_Temporary") && NOT(ISCHANGED(IME_Nb_Competitor__c)) && NOT(ISCHANGED(IME_Nb_NoUnknownCompetitor__c)) && NOT(ISCHANGED(IME_Winning_Competitors__c)) && NOT(ISCHANGED(IM_Has_Competitors__c)) && (RecordTypeId = "01280000000BDei" || RecordTypeId = "01280000000BDeh"|| RecordTypeId = "01280000000BDec") && NOT($Permission.Edit_Opps_in_Stage_6 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have permission to update an Opportunity once it has reached Stage 6 or 7.
